entries.source: AI map guidance separates earthworks from finished planting.

drafts.zu: Imiyalelo yamamephu e-AI ihlukanisa umsebenzi womhlaba nokutshala okuqediwe.
drafts.st: Ditaelo tsa dimmapa tsa AI di arola mesebetsi ya mobu le temo e seng e jetswe.
drafts.ts: Swiletelo swa mimepe ya AI swi hambanisa mintirho ya misava ni ku byala loku hetisisiweke.
drafts.ve: Ndaela dza mapa a AI dzi khethekanya mishumo ya mavu na u ṱavha ho no fhelaho.
